For independent plan review. Evidence below is planned, not executed. No product code is authorized by this planning run.

There is no `docs/tdd/E29.md`, `docs/requests/E29.md` or `docs/tdd/reviews/E29.*` in this checkout. Plan from `docs/product/tdd/E29.md:7`, SYSTEM and Part A, without creating a design. `hub/`, `ui/`, `eval/`, generated contracts and non-pharmacy runtime configuration are absent. The existing Python project, configuration and contracts belong to the pharmacy engine. Do not replace them.

| Task | Owned concern | Dependencies |

| T1 | GroundLink state, simulated contact queue, bundle agent and transport recovery; `groundlink` module and tests | E01 kernel/platform/toolchain and real E23 mission; P29-1/2/3 below before affected bindings |
| T2 | Approved catch-up composition, ground presentation and delivered-only `getGroundLog`; `catchup` module and tests | Agreed P29-1/2 ports; optional providers add facts; no dependency on T1 implementation for unit work |

| T4 | Real-stack scenarios, static/read-trace evidence and published comparison results | T1, T2, T3 plus actual providers for each positive scenario |

T1, T2 and T3 can develop independently after the coordinator settles their shared signatures. Use only actual provider application protocols and E01 `kernel.testing` for unit work (SYSTEM 9/10, `docs/SYSTEM.md:2388`). Freeze the agreed E29 port declarations before dependent coders start. Integration uses normal `module.py` discovery, never shared app edits (SYSTEM 5.12). The link changes publish `ground_link.changed`; E24 alone evaluates ground silence; E23 renders Habitat. E26 owns preview, press, approved GroundMessage content and lifecycle; E16 owns handoffs, ground console, receipts and replies. T2 supplies composition and presentation through the agreed ports, and T1 transports only already approved projections. No second queue, ledger or ground-message state machine in another epic.

Ownership is instantiated from SYSTEM 4.1/4.2/6.1: `hub/src/crew_health/groundlink/`, `hub/src/crew_health/catchup/`, matching `hub/tests/` trees, `ui/crew/src/features/catchup/` and `eval/scenarios/E29/` (`docs/SYSTEM.md:74`, `docs/SYSTEM.md:92`, `docs/SYSTEM.md:112`, `docs/SYSTEM.md:1625`). Rechecked all available epic task manifests and other designs' ownership sections. These trees have no competing owner. Recheck at dispatch because other planners are writing concurrently. No E29 task owns shared configuration, shell, offline store, fixture, runner, deployment packaging or provider files.

## Design decisions

- **Seams:** SYSTEM 6.4 permits direct link-port reads only in `groundlink`, `catchup`, `mission` for Habitat/context and `rules` for ground silence (`docs/SYSTEM.md:1677`). Plans/help/handoffs receive ground presentation through catchup, never a legacy link reader. This is three consumer purposes plus the provider, not permission for any code in those modules to gate care on contact. Several named ports have no authoritative complete signature; P29-1 is a dispatch prerequisite, not a proposed local protocol.
- **Time:** use SYSTEM 5.1 to 5.4 injected IDs, corrected observation time, mission labels and unit-qualified durations. Explicit contact instants and schedule windows are absolute; retry/arrival durations are elapsed deadlines through SYSTEM 5.10 (`docs/SYSTEM.md:1309`). Persist anchors/generations, never recompute accepted approval times, text or hashes after a correction. Unknown contact/delay stays null/unknown. No measured source is synthesized. `getGroundLog` uses explicit `since` inclusively or start of the last gap, as `docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:11638` specifies; there is no invented lookback duration. P29-2 settles no-prior-gap and multi-gap selection and bounded full-result behavior.
- **Approval and transport:** approved lines/text/hash and catch-up are immutable. E26 snapshots and commits them during the press, with its complete fallback if E29 is absent (SYSTEM 8.1, `docs/SYSTEM.md:1953`). Optional providers may not enrich an approved message later. New facts need another approval. A bundle is a delivery attempt, not a clinical record. Use SYSTEM 5.7.1 recipient streams, policy epochs, transactional cursors and revocation. File drop is the independent backup to an optional DTN daemon; loss of both leaves a durable visible queue and all onboard care usable (DEPLOYMENT 3.8/4.6).
- **Failure cases:** no acknowledgment until the owner transaction commits. Disk, I/O, integrity and authorization failures escape, never become an empty successful log or fallback. Crash/retry at snapshot approval, materialization, file write, send, import and ACK preserves the same approved content. E01 owns transaction/file-side-effect recovery and deduplication; request missing file-finalization bindings rather than build another shared mechanism. Revalidate grants before send/import/read and renewal. Different hashes for the same transport identity are corruption. Late/duplicate replies append once and never change care. Queue/byte exhaustion fails visibly without truncating or deleting accepted records.
- **FHIR:** SYSTEM 7.3 and existing R-SYS-2 keep export off until `export-mapping.json` is signed, pinned and validated (`docs/SYSTEM.md:1766`, `docs/requests/SYSTEM.md:17`). No export endpoint exists in the opened OpenAPI. Build no speculative exporter, mapping, endpoint or medicine adapter. Approved handoffs and catch-up still work. T4 verifies this fence; FHIR validation is not claimed. Coordinator-owned mapping/port propagation is P29-5.

Bounds use existing SYSTEM 5.11 descriptors only, with validated finite limits and their stated basis. No mission default is invented.

| Work | Existing setting family |
|---|---|
| Snapshot, SQL result, text admission and output bytes | `commands.max_bytes`, `storage.max_rows`, `storage.max_statement_bytes`, `sync.max_bytes` |
| Materialization, import, dependency buffers and transport calls | `sync.page_entries`, `sync.pending_max`, `sync.timeout_ms`, `sync.retry_max`, `sync.max_projection_fields`, `sync.max_dependencies` |
| Envelope construction, inflight attempts and renewal | `bundle.max_bytes`, `bundle.max_inflight`, `bundle.retry_max`, `bundle.retry_backoff_ms`, `bundle.renewal_batch` |
| Dispatch, events and startup | `scheduler.batch_size`, `scheduler.max_jobs`, `scheduler.retry_max`, `scheduler.retry_backoff_ms`, `event_bus.max_events`, `events.page_size`, registry bounds |
| Agent calls, health and restart | `workers.<name>.*` for the ground link agent as registered with E20; exact descriptors must be delivered under P29-3 |

Content comes from read-only release documents: `environment-profiles.json` (`comms_queue`, `link`), `environment-hazards.json` (`earth_delay`), `ui-copy.json` (link, gap, duration, catch-up and unknown words), `help-presentation.json` and pinned plan/flow documents. Their existing owners make edits. Missing D11 lifetime disables BPv7 only; simulated contact/local approved queues remain usable. Expiry renews the envelope with a new transport identity and current configured lifetime, the same approved snapshot/hash/priority, original approval ordering and current consent. Never delete unacknowledged approved content (`docs/DEPLOYMENT.md:346`).

## End to end evidence

T4 owns tests and generated evidence under `eval/scenarios/E29/`; E21 imports their results through its registry, which E29 does not edit. Every row is mandatory, with stable test IDs in the briefs. Use E21's explicit demo fixture and real `create_app(settings)` HTTP composition with temporary on-disk SQLite, or Playwright against that running hub. No in-hub mocks, provider substitution, direct SQL seeds, response interception or dependency overrides. External optional processes are absent or use documented adapters. Kernel fakes cannot earn these passes. Required absent providers fail acceptance rather than skip or xfail.

| Test ID and trace | Proof |
|---|---|
| E29-LINK: R49, E29-01/05, D33 | Mara confirms Moon activation, operator selects the planned SIM gap, every actual link change emits after commit, Habitat shows state/contact/source and only its ground line changes. LIVE rejects demo mutation. Schedule restoration and activation use actual E23. |
| E29-INDEPENDENCE: R48, EI1/EI2/EI5, V81, D34/D43 | At one injected instant and release, getPlan for ICL10, eye_injury help flow/session, getKitMap, listWarnings and routine responses are identical for up/delayed/down after only the exact ground presentation leaves are replaced by a fixed sentinel. Plan exception is ground_log link_text/leaves_at only. Warnings, care states, IDs, revisions, timestamps, order and availability are never removed. Keep threshold null or use a planned gap here; V93 is separate. Publish all response hashes, exact permitted differences, source/build/release pins, complete static code/configuration/state-set scan inventory and reference-only actual read trace. A forbidden module/alias/DI reader or changed care field must make the test fail. No empty-source scan passes. |
| E29-SILENCE: R49, E29-03, V93, D35 | Real E24 rule: configured nonnull threshold raises watch only after next_contact_at plus threshold for an unplanned down gap. Null threshold, unknown contact and planned gaps raise nothing. Test boundary equality, clock corrections, duplicates, release pins and legitimate clear semantics without altering safety mappings. Threshold is scratch SIM content with provenance, never a shipped clinical default. |
| E29-OUTAGE: R61, E29-04/05, D40/D42, charter 6 complete log | Real E16 handoff and E26 preview/press queue with leaves_at; continue plan/help ticks while down. Restore contact, restart around every delivery/ACK boundary, renew expired envelopes and recover every approved snapshot exactly once at the ground. Model/devices absent; remove DTN for file fallback, then file transport for visible durable queue. Same-key retry beyond 24 hours cannot approve new content. Journal/report/cross-person canaries are absent from recipient plaintext, events and diagnostics. Current grants/revocation govern every path. |
| E29-REPLY: R61, V95, EI5 | Deliver real E16/E26 replies after plan/help closure; append authenticated new records exactly once; compare all care state before/after. Wrong recipient/signature/hash, stale epoch and missing required dependency cannot apply. Receipt is not clinical review. |
| E29-OFFLINE: R62, E29-06, V97 | Populate real E20/E26/E28 caches for each supported crew browser/device profile with teach content. Stop hub, model, devices and link. First help screen and active plan steps render with their pinned release; teach content remains available. Scratch activation updates the active cache atomically, open work keeps its pin, invalid release leaves last good. Owner switch reveals no other person's clinical state. No cache implementation belongs to E29. |

These tests include crash/power loss, duplicate/reordered delivery, clock jumps/mission boundaries, disk full, corrupt/missing configuration, concurrent clients, long backlog, incapacitated/absent subject and cross-crew privacy. Partial or disagreeing clinical facts retain their source/units and appear unknown/conflicted, never averaged or defaulted in a summary. Configuration-edit tests for T1/T2/T3 change a nonclinical sourced label/template in a scratch release and prove output changes without code changes. EI3/EI4/EI6 to EI12 remain provider invariants, not new E29 engines. No clinical golden result is derived from the same content being tested.

## Gates and hand-in

Task commands are in `tasks.json`. Hub commands select the standalone uv project and its pytest configuration (SYSTEM 6.2); UI uses pnpm (6.3). Import rules are generated before lint-imports (6.4). Coverage collection targets domain/application only; combined coverage is not evidence of 95 percent branch coverage per file. P29-3 supplies actual implementations and E29 inventories for the existing stricter commands copied from the E01 build plan before greenlight. The separate root `validate_contracts.py` command is the charter's pharmacy/contract check, not proof of E29 configuration validity; the hub corpus/contract gates supply that evidence. T4 runs all E29 tests plus the full built hub suite; bug fixes rerun full suites. No filtering, suppression, skip, xfail or unavailable-provider success can earn acceptance. CI and independent build review remain required.

Planning validation checks JSON shape, task DAG, disjoint ownership against current manifests, source citations and punctuation. Runtime, browser, fault, coverage, mutation and CI gates have not run because their implementation prerequisites are absent. No design-lint success is claimed for a nonexistent E29 design. No git command or product-code write is part of this run.
